_note: Tag vocabulary PER SUBJECT. One place: the ALLOWED TAGS line in the generation
prompt and the validator's accept/reject rule both read the mission's own
subject's list from here, so the two can never disagree.
A subject with no entry below REFUSES generation, naming the subject. There is
deliberately no fallback: Robotics missions were about to be forced to wear
computer science tags (loops, recursion, sorting) because this file held one
global list, and a silent fallback is how that would have shipped.
